categories.evidence: Touches the script interpreter (`CastToBool`), carrying the Consensus label.
categories.rationale: Optimizes worst-case script execution time for truthiness checks on large stack elements. Author benchmarks demonstrate a 3.1x speedup (922ms down to 295ms) on synthetic worst-case scripts exercising OP_IFDUP and OP_VERIFY, offering a modest improvement against validation-time CPU exhaustion.
